title: Tenma Saki — Sports Festival Committee!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heeey! Saki! Haruka! I finally made it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good, you're here. That's everyone so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! The Sports Festival Planning Committee has one last job to do!
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho, Minori...
Thank you for taking the time to do this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No problem. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You took a lot of photos during the Sports Festival, right? Mind sending them over to me too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you want my pictures?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gathering as many as we can and choosing the best ones to put in the yearbook♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For example... This one's definitely going in!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's that...? No, wait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aww, it's Shiho during the ball toss!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Seeing all those animal designs gave the most wonderhoy smile!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I-I didn't realize someone was taking pics of me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... You know it was us who made all of those, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We drew animals on them hoping to get a cute reaction from you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you serious about putting this one in the yearbook?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Dead serious!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So anyway, we're looking for great shots like this one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If you have any more like that one, please send it my way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I see...! I wish could send you something, but I only took videos...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, I think Kohane might be able to help...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, she was taking pics with a DSLR.
She must've taken lots of good photos.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cool! That sounds promising!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She went to have lunch, so I'll let her know you need her photos when she gets back!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great! Thanks, Minori!
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You need photos for the yearbook?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! If you have any good ones that you can share, let me know!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Oh, then I can help...!
It has Honami and Emu in it!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Here, this one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh! Oh my goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey! It's us eating an apple pie together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! That's priceless! You both looked up at the camera with the best expression!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: I called out to them saying that I wanted to take a picture, and they both turned towards camera with the exact same face!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nooo, please stop staring! My mouth's wide open and it so embarrassing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But it's sooo cute!
It totally deserves an award!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. And it captures how close you two are so well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It would be great addition for the yearbook.
Would that be okay, Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?! Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honamiii...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're begging you...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Uh... Well... If you all like it so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Hona!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, we got so many photos!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone was happy to share their pictures with us, so it didn't take long to get enough good ones.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess it's because they all had a great time during the Sport Festival and wanted to share their joy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Each of the pictures they sent us today... They're all treasured memories from their wonderful teenage lives...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we helped make these memories!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We won't be able to use every photo for the yearbook...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I hope the ones we choose will help everyone remember how excited they were that day.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Once we hand them over to the head of the student council, our work is officially done...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! And it was sooo much fun organizing the Sports Festival with you, Saki, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I did this!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
